title: Build a Level
goal: A level is a layout of blocks, coins, and bad guys.
mascot_lines: A level is one chunk of a game — a single screen or stage.
Levels usually get harder as you go, and they each teach you one new thing.
Beating a tough level feels really, really good.
Good levels are how we keep a game feeling fresh from start to finish.

tier2.rephrase: Order the steps to build a fun level.

tier3.nudge: First make the floor. Then add stuff. Then test. Then fix what is too hard!

questions.math_tip: Read the labels, then add for a total or subtract to compare.

variations.prompt: A picture graph shows 4 red votes and 3 blue votes. How many more votes did the winner get?

questions.math_tip: Read hundreds, tens, then ones. Each place is worth ten times the place to its right.

variations.prompt: In 762, which digit is in the tens place?

questions.math_tip: Add the ones first. Ten ones can be regrouped as one ten.

variations.prompt: What is 58 plus 17?
